## Capstone Project reports
### 1. HMIS Service vs Disease Data Analysis
This project quantified and characterized discrepancies between confirmed malaria positives reported through HMIS service reporting stream and confirmed cases recorded in disease reporting stream, and propose an evidence-informed approach to support NMEP in selecting and interpreting malaria data for routine analysis and reporting.

[View Report](reports/SService_vs_Disease_data_comparative_analysis.pdf)

### 2. HMIS-driven interactive dashboard
This project developed an interactive HMIS-driven malaria dashboard to strengthen routine monitoring and evidence-based decision-making in the NMEP.

[View Report](reports/HMIS_driven_interacive_dashboard.pdf)


## Operational researches
### 1.Malaria trend before and after non-HRP RDT roll out in Ethiopia
This research is an observational study which assessed the status of key HMIS malaria indicators pre and post non-HRP RDT rollout in Ethiopia.

[View Report](reports/Malaria_trend_preand_post_non_HRP RDT_analysis.pdf)

### 2.Effect of the targeted cluster initiative on malaria indicators in Ethiopia 
This research employed a non-randomized controlled before-and-after (CBA) study design to assess changes in malaria outcomes during and after the Targeted Cluster Initiative (TCI), a six-month intervention launched in June 2024 in Ethiopia in response to the country’s malaria resurgence. The study aimed to generate an accessible evidence base to inform the planning and implementation of future malaria response interventions.

[View Report](reports/TCI_impact_study.pdf)

## NMEP monthly bulletins
The monthly malaria bulletins were designed and maintained for the National Malaria Elimination Program. They provide regular summaries of malaria surveillance, trends, and key programmatic activities.

The link below provides access to 13 monthly NMEP bulletins, covering the period from July 2025 onward.

[Download the 13 Monthly NMEP Bulletins](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1n6PEx5TtkzSV9KVZvpEzL7H2hIRgWT4B/view?usp=sharing)
